title: Fix testing-guide.md's copy-paste test examples — they import AppDatabase/CompletionsCompanion/UserMode, all deleted in the schema-v1 rebuild

evidence.quote:
/// Write methods ([insertCompletion], [insertCompletionsBatch]) have been
/// removed.  New completions are written exclusively through

why: testing-guide.md is required reading (index.md step 5) and its 'How to Write a Unit Test', 'How to Write a Widget Test', 'How to Write a Story Acceptance Test', 'How to Write an Integration Test' sections, plus the 'Test Infrastructure Details' section that quotes test/helpers/test_database.dart verbatim, all use `AppDatabase`/`CompletionsCompanion.insert(...)`/`db.completionDao.insertCompletion(...)`/`UserMode` — every one of which was deleted in the schema-v1 rebuild (the DB class is now UserDatabase in core/database/user/user_database.dart; the `completions` table and CompletionDao's write methods were removed outright per the DAO's own doc comment; UserMode was replaced by ProfileMode in core/domain/value_objects/). A contributor or AI agent copy-pasting the guide's primary teaching example gets an immediate compile failure against a non-existent API surface — the exact opposite of what a 'how to write a test' doc should do. The quoted 'test/helpers/test_database.dart' snippet is also simply not what that file contains today.
recommendation: Rewrite all four code samples and the Test Infrastructure Details snippet against the current UserDatabase/CompletionEventDao/CompletionWriter/ProfileMode APIs; also refresh the '531+ tests across 167 files' and '14 epic tags and 62 story tags' counts (actual: dart_test.yaml has 20 epic tags / 97 story tags, and ~10,353 test()/testWidgets() calls across 780 files, per test-options.md's already-accurate figure).
acceptance_criteria: every code block in testing-guide.md compiles against current lib/ (spot-checked by pasting into a scratch test file)
epic/story tag counts and the test_database.dart snippet match dart_test.yaml and test/helpers/test_database.dart
